opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts institutions or registered charities delivering fine and performing arts training for school‑age children under 18; institutions may apply once per round; individuals cannot apply.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide training opportunities (e.g., weekend, after‑school, holiday programmes) for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions (not universities) that can demonstrate outstanding teaching; institutions may apply once per round; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per year per student for undergraduate or postgraduate arts students in need.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 salary contribution year 1, up to £28,000 year 2‑3, plus up to £6,000 research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, are UK residents, and meet specific career‑break and teaching‑load criteria.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who are UK residents, have held a UK university post with research degree‑awarding powers, and meet the two‑year gap rule.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete or integrate a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each (total up to £50 million) to fund up to 30 doctoral scholarships and related activities

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research‑degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities). Applications are made by the university, not by individual students.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (including additional places for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral opportunities) over a 9‑year programme.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (single or collaborative) with research‑degree awarding powers; up to one principal application per university.
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship; up to ten centres funded for up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (full‑time) plus up to £6,000 per year research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university; must not already hold a professorial title.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships to enable senior scholars to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who wish to build a research team; must not have held a similar award before.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to develop research leadership and a modest research team over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations; principal investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative, original research projects of up to five years, with a strong emphasis on fundamental research.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university (or specialist arts institution) must host; applicant must be a senior academic from overseas; host must be UK academic staff.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite eminent senior professors from overseas to enhance skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers (not independent scholars) holding a UK university post with research‑degree awarding powers; must be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers, particularly those whose routine duties have limited their ability to complete a research programme.
